title: For organisations: workplace culture, hiring, team coaching and training in Italy – Blooming
description: Processes and roles, hiring for key roles, team coaching, tailored training and outplacement, in English or Italian, with a psychologist who has worked in HR for over ten years. Project-based, with a free first meeting.

data.title: A healthier workplace culture is possible.

p.t: Good people leave, and the reason given is always "personal". A promising hire is gone within six months. A team gets the work done, but nobody says what they really think. When this keeps happening, the cause is rarely one person.

data.title: Culture is made of everyday decisions.

p.t: Who gets hired and how, how roles and responsibilities are split, how a team works together, what training is actually needed. Elsa, a psychologist, has worked in HR for over ten years, in recruitment, training and change management, with international experience. Dagmara works on organisational process analysis.
We look at those decisions with you, in English or Italian, and help you change the ones that matter most. We'd rather fix a few specific things properly than promise to transform your culture.

data.title: Five areas, from processes to people.

p.t: We map how your HR processes work today, through interviews and surveys with the people involved, and redesign workflows, roles and structure where needed.
We help you define the profile, assess skills and follow up once the person starts.
For teams that need to work together better, handle a conflict, get through a change or find their motivation again.
We work out what's needed and design the programme, with you if you like. We deliver it, or refer you to a specialist training provider.
